actions.description: Durably fence the failed primary, promote the replica, and atomically cut over the proxy
actions.command:
python - <<'PY'
import hashlib, os, sqlite3, tempfile
base = '/var/lib/failover'
db_path = os.path.join(base, 'records.sqlite3')
failed = os.path.join(base, 'primary.failed')
fenced = os.path.join(base, 'primary.fenced')
role = os.path.join(base, 'replica.role')
upstream = os.path.join(base, 'upstream')

assert os.path.exists(failed), 'primary.failed must be preserved'
with open(db_path, 'rb') as f:
    before_hash = hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()
con = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
rows = con.execute('SELECT id, value FROM records ORDER BY id').fetchall()
con.close()
